== Template:Item/Mold ==

Template for displaying crafting mold tooltips.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon image filename
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Mold name
|-
| '''value''' || No || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|-
| '''description''' || No || Flavor text
|-
| '''ingredients''' || No || Required ingredients (formatted list)
|-
| '''rewards''' || No || Created items (formatted list)
|-
| '''station''' || No || Required crafting station
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Mold
|image=Mold: A Ceremonial Ring.png
|name=Mold: A Ceremonial Ring
|ingredients=1x [[Chunk of Copper Ore]]<br/>1x [[Sivakayan Horn]]<br/>1x [[Luminstone]]<br/>1x [[Sivakrux]]
|rewards=1x [[Ceremonial Ring]]
|station=Forge
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Mold
|image=Mold: A Ceremonial Ring.png
|name=Mold: A Ceremonial Ring
|ingredients=1x [[Chunk of Copper Ore]]<br/>1x [[Sivakayan Horn]]<br/>1x [[Luminstone]]<br/>1x [[Sivakrux]]
|rewards=1x [[Ceremonial Ring]]
|station=Forge
}}

----

=== Sub-templates Used ===

* [[Template:Item/Header]] - Icon and name display
* [[Template:Item/Categories]] - Auto-categorization
